name: ta488
description: TA488, also known as Void Blizzard or Laundry Bear, is a high‑profiling Russia‑aligned adversary that exploited the Zimbra CVE‑2025‑66376 cross‑site scripting vulnerability for near‑zero‑click attacks against government, defense and energy sectors worldwide. The group achieved persistence via injected scripts and app‑specific passwords while exfiltrating emails, credentials and two‑factor tokens through covert DNS tunneling and HTTP uploads. After the public disclosure of CVE‑2025‑66376 in early 2026, TA488 appears to have halted active operations.
